newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar down on low demand, surplus stocks.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar down on low demand, surplus stocks.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Tuesday on low consumer demand and a surplus of stocks, dealers said.

Ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by 5/15 rupees to 1,240/1,285 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by 25/30 rupees to 1,270/1,320 rupees. Sugar mill delivery also fell to 1,180 rupees from 1,195 on little demand from outstation buyers.
Closing sentiment was weak and traders feared more losses.
The sugar trade is closed on Wednesday and Thursday to mark the birth anniversary of a veteran unionist and for a local religious festival. It will reopen for trading on Friday.
